fusions.name: Stinger Spray
fusions.desc: Fires 4 stinging rounds in a spread, each dealing 2 poison damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Detonation
fusions.desc: Fires a round at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 16 poison damage, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Humming Emplacement
fusions.desc: Plants a humming emplacement that stands for 12 seconds and fires at an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 poison damage every second.

fusions.name: Hive Tempo
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you move and attack 18% faster for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
